packageRules.description: takt is pinned to the same version across the event-store-adapter repositories and updated by the coordinator in all repositories at once (repository policy, chapter 8), so Renovate must not update it.

rustdoc-types must match the rustdoc JSON format of the nightly pinned in api-surface/check/src/rustdoc.rs and the api-surface CI job, so it is updated together with that nightly by hand (api-surface/README.md).
